A heart shape made of sparkling lights, emphasizing love and priority
words.image_desc_en: A trophy on a shelf and a heart of lights, representing priority.
words.image_desc_cn: 奖杯和心形灯光，代表优先和喜爱。
words.usage: 短语。表示在所有事物中最喜欢或最重视的。
words.collocations: remember most of all, enjoy most of all, like most of all

examples.en: I like summer, but I like spring most of all.
examples.cn: 我喜欢夏天，但我最喜欢春天。

examples.en: We should study hard, but we must relax most of all.
examples.cn: 我们应该努力学习，但最重要的是放松。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有很多爱好，哪个是你投入最多时间、感觉最快乐的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：表达在所有爱好中最喜欢、最重视的那一个。

sentences: I love all fruits, but I like apples ___ ___ ___.

image_prompts: A golden coin with a prominent number indicating its worth
A family heirloom, such as a vintage watch, displayed on velvet
words.image_desc_en: A golden coin and a family heirloom.
words.image_desc_cn: 一枚金币和一个传家宝。
words.meaning_cn: n. 价值；重要性 v. 评估；重视
words.usage: n. (复数 values) ; v. (过去式 valued, 过去分词 valued)
words.collocations: high value, great value, add value to

examples.en: I really value your opinion on this important school project.
examples.cn: 我非常重视你对这个重要学校项目的意见。

examples.en: The value of this old book is higher than I thought.
examples.cn: 这本书的价值比我想象的要高。

socratic_questions.question: 当你在做选择时，什么对你来说是最重要的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑什么是最有意义和值得的。

sentences: We should ___ our friendships and the time we spend together.

image_prompts: A hand placing a ballot into a voting box, emphasizing the free choice aspect
A group of people cleaning up a park, showing community service without pay
words.image_desc_en: Voluntary action implies doing something willingly without being forced or paid.
words.image_desc_cn: 自愿行为意味着自愿做某事，没有被强迫或支付报酬。
words.collocations: voluntary work, voluntary organization, voluntary service

examples.en: She does voluntary work at the local animal shelter every week.
examples.cn: 她每周都会在当地的动物收容所做志愿工作。

examples.en: Our school has a voluntary program to help elderly people.
examples.cn: 我们学校有一个志愿项目来帮助老年人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你主动选择参加一个社区活动，没有报酬，这是什么行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个行为是出于你自己的意愿，而不是被要求或为了钱。

sentences: His participation in the project was completely ___ and not required.

image_prompts: A plain, unadorned ceramic mug on a wooden table
A row of identical houses in a suburban neighborhood, overcast sky
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of something common and unremarkable.
words.image_desc_cn: 普通且不引人注目的事物的图示。
words.collocations: ordinary life, ordinary people, quite ordinary

examples.en: This is just an ordinary day at our school, nothing special.
examples.cn: 这只是我们学校里一个普通的日子，没什么特别的。

examples.en: He leads an ordinary life, working and spending time with family.
examples.cn: 他过着普通的生活，工作并和家人共度时光。

socratic_questions.question: 如果某件事或某个人没有特别之处，你会用什么词来形容？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是常见且不突出的事物。

sentences: It was an ___ afternoon, nothing exciting happened at all.

image_prompts: A vintage scale with gold coins on one side and a certificate on the other, balanced
A worn treasure map leading to a chest overflowing with jewels and gold
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing value and importance.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表价值和重要性的插图。
words.usage: adj. having a specified value; n. value
words.collocations: be worth doing, be worth something, prove worth

examples.en: This book is worth reading because it has a great story.
examples.cn: 这本书值得一读，因为它有一个很棒的故事。

examples.en: The old painting is worth a lot of money now.
examples.cn: 这幅古老的画现在价值很多钱。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你发现了一件东西，你觉得它很有用或者很珍贵，你会怎么形容它的价值？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示某物具有积极的价值或重要性。

sentences: This old car is still ___ repairing, even though it needs work.

image_prompts: Rows of empty theater seats facing a stage with a spotlight
A large concert hall filled with blurred figures, stage lights glowing
words.image_desc_en: A group of people gathered to watch a performance.
words.image_desc_cn: 聚集在一起观看表演的一群人。
words.collocations: large audience, attract an audience, address the audience
words.preposition_combos: in front of the audience, to the audience

examples.en: The audience clapped loudly after the band finished their last song.
examples.cn: 乐队结束最后一首歌后，观众们热烈鼓掌。

examples.en: The speaker paused to look at the audience before continuing his speech.
examples.cn: 演讲者停顿了一下，看了看观众，然后继续他的演讲。

socratic_questions.question: 在音乐会或戏剧表演中，坐在座位上观看演出的人们被称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 他们是表演的接收者，通过观看和倾听来参与其中。

sentences: The film received a positive response from the test ___.

image_prompts: A hand reaching out to help another hand climb a steep hill, teamwork
A volunteer wearing a bright vest, planting a tree seedling in a park
words.image_desc_en: A helping hand and a volunteer planting a tree.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只援助之手和一个志愿者在植树。
words.collocations: willing to help, willing participant, perfectly willing

examples.en: She is always willing to help her classmates with their studies.
examples.cn: 她总是乐于帮助她的同学学习。

examples.en: I am willing to try new things and face new challenges.
examples.cn: 我愿意尝试新事物并面对新的挑战。

socratic_questions.question: 如果有人主动提出帮你解决问题，你会用哪个词来形容他的态度？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示一种积极主动，乐于助人的心态。

sentences: Are you ___ to join our school's environmental protection club?

image_prompts: A steaming cup of coffee next to a pair of running shoes and a backpack
A smartphone displaying a map with a moving car icon, indicating travel
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing constant activity and movement.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表持续活动和移动的视觉效果。
words.collocations: be on the go, always on the go

examples.en: She is always on the go with her many hobbies.
examples.cn: 她总是很忙碌，因为她有很多爱好。

examples.en: I've been on the go all day, so I'm very tired.
examples.cn: 我一整天都在奔波，所以我很累。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人每天都参加各种活动，没有休息时间，你会怎么形容他/她的状态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个人非常活跃，一直在行动中，没有停下来。

sentences: He is always ___ because he has a lot of work.

image_prompts: A cracked piggy bank with only a few coins inside, symbolizing financial difficulty
A wilted plant in a dry pot, representing a lack of care and attention
words.image_desc_en: A visual representation of lacking essential resources or assistance.
words.image_desc_cn: 缺乏基本资源或帮助的视觉表现。
words.usage: 短语. 表示处于困境或需要帮助的状态。
words.collocations: be in need of, help those in need

examples.en: The animal shelter helps pets that are in need of care.
examples.cn: 这家动物收容所帮助那些需要照顾的宠物。

examples.en: We should help those who are in need during disasters.
examples.cn: 在灾难期间，我们应该帮助那些需要帮助的人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果有人遭遇了意外事故，急需医疗救助，我们可以说他们处于什么状态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 他们缺乏必要的帮助，情况紧急。

sentences: The charity provides food and shelter to families ___ of assistance.

image_prompts: A jigsaw puzzle with all pieces perfectly fitted together, creating a seamless image
A freshly painted wall with an even, flawless coat of paint, no streaks or imperfections
words.image_desc_en: Represents thoroughness and perfection.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表彻底和完美。
words.collocations: completely different, completely agree, completely understand

examples.en: I completely forgot about the meeting this morning; I am so sorry.
examples.cn: 我完全忘记了今天早上的会议；非常抱歉。

examples.en: The rain completely ruined our picnic plans, so we stayed inside.
examples.cn: 这场雨彻底毁了我们的野餐计划，所以我们待在室内。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你把一个任务从头到尾、一点不落地做完了，可以说你做得怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 强调没有遗漏，全部完成。

sentences: She was ___ exhausted after running the marathon; she could barely stand.

image_prompts: A gold medal hanging on a ribbon, sparkling background
A graduation cap thrown in the air, blue sky background
words.image_desc_en: A gold medal and a graduation cap thrown in the air represent success.
words.image_desc_cn: 金牌和抛向空中的毕业帽代表成功。
words.collocations: achieve success, a great success, lead to success

examples.en: Hard work is the key to success in any field.
examples.cn: 努力工作是在任何领域取得成功的关键。

examples.en: The project was a great success, exceeding all expectations.
examples.cn: 这个项目非常成功，超出了所有预期。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你努力学习并通过了考试，你会感到什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示你实现了目标，获得了好的结果。

sentences: Her hard work led to her ___ in the competition.

image_prompts: A gnarled oak tree with deep wrinkles in its bark, sunlight filtering through leaves
A set of antique books with leather covers and gold lettering, arranged on a shelf
words.image_desc_en: An old tree and antique books symbolize age and experience.
words.image_desc_cn: 老树和古董书象征着年龄和经验。
words.usage: adj. (比较级 elder, 最高级 eldest); n.
words.collocations: elder brother, elder sister, elder generation

examples.en: My elder sister helps me with my homework every day.
examples.cn: 我的姐姐每天都帮助我做作业。

examples.en: We should respect our elder relatives and listen to them.
examples.cn: 我们应该尊重我们的长辈亲戚并听取他们的意见。

socratic_questions.question: 在家庭聚会上，谁通常会讲述过去的故事，分享他们的生活经验？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个人通常比其他家庭成员年龄大，并且拥有更多的生活经验。

sentences: The ___ members of the club have a lot of experience.

image_prompts: A collection box overflowing with various denominations of paper currency.
A stack of canned goods arranged neatly on a table, ready for distribution.
words.image_desc_en: A collection box filled with money; canned goods ready for charity.
words.image_desc_cn: 装满钱的捐款箱；准备好用于慈善事业的罐头食品。
words.collocations: donate money, donate blood, donate time

examples.en: We should donate some old books to the school library.
examples.cn: 我们应该捐赠一些旧书给学校图书馆。

examples.en: Many people donate money to help those in need.
examples.cn: 许多人捐款来帮助那些需要帮助的人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有一些不再需要的物品或金钱，你会怎么处理，让它们帮助到别人？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个行为指的是把东西给予需要的人或组织。

sentences: She decided to ___ her old clothes to a local charity shop.

image_prompts: An empty denim pocket turned inside out, revealing the lining
A collection of colorful pebbles and seashells spilling out of a cloth pocket
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting an empty pocket and items spilling from a pocket.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示空口袋和物品从口袋里溢出的插图。
words.collocations: in one's pocket, pickpocket, pocket money

examples.en: I always keep some coins in my pocket for emergencies.
examples.cn: 我总是在口袋里放一些硬币以备不时之需。

examples.en: She reached into her pocket and pulled out a small key.
examples.cn: 她伸手进口袋，掏出了一把小钥匙。

socratic_questions.question: 当你需要随身携带小物件，比如钥匙或零钱时，你会放在哪里？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个地方通常缝在衣服上，用来装东西。

sentences: He felt his phone vibrate in his ___ during the meeting.

image_prompts: A small pile of coins and banknotes on a wooden table.
A piggy bank overflowing with coins, next to a handwritten budget.
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting a small amount of money and a piggy bank.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘少量金钱和储蓄罐的图像。
words.collocations: earn pocket money, save pocket money, spend pocket money

examples.en: I save my pocket money to buy a new video game.
examples.cn: 我攒零花钱为了买一个新的电子游戏。

examples.en: She gets pocket money every week for doing chores at home.
examples.cn: 她每周做家务得到零花钱。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你每周从父母那里得到一些钱，可以自己支配，这叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这笔钱通常不多，可以用来买小零食或玩具。

sentences: He uses his ___ to buy snacks after school every day.

image_prompts: A person's hand reaching for a mountain peak, symbolizing striving
A close-up of a determined face with sweat droplets, showing exertion
words.image_desc_en: Images representing striving and exertion.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表努力和费力的图像。
words.collocations: make an effort, put in effort, with effort

examples.en: He made an effort to learn English well before the exam.
examples.cn: 他在考试前努力学好英语。

examples.en: She put in a lot of effort to finish the project on time.
examples.cn: 她付出了很多努力来按时完成项目。

socratic_questions.question: 为了完成一项困难的任务，你需要投入什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示为达成目标而付出的能量和时间。

sentences: It takes a lot of ___ to learn a new language well.

image_prompts: A stack of flyers being distributed from a table, blurred hands reaching for them
A teacher's desk with papers being placed on each student's desk, top-down view
words.image_desc_en: Distribution of items or information.
words.image_desc_cn: 分发物品或信息。
words.collocations: hand out flyers, hand out books, hand out information

examples.en: The teacher will hand out the exam papers soon.
examples.cn: 老师很快会分发试卷。

examples.en: Please hand out these leaflets to everyone you see.
examples.cn: 请把这些传单分发给所有你看到的人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有很多传单，你需要做什么让每个人都拿到一份？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作是将东西给予很多人。

sentences: Volunteers will ___ free water bottles at the marathon's starting line.

image_prompts: A well-worn map with highlighted routes and landmarks, suggesting frequent use
A collection of tools neatly organized in a toolbox, each in its designated place
words.image_desc_en: A map showing familiar routes and a toolbox with tools in their place.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张地图，显示熟悉的路线；一个工具箱，工具各就各位。
words.usage: adj. knowing something or someone well
words.collocations: become familiar with, quite familiar with, generally familiar with

examples.en: I am familiar with the rules of this interesting board game.
examples.cn: 我熟悉这个有趣的棋盘游戏的规则。

examples.en: She is familiar with the local customs and traditions here.
examples.cn: 她熟悉当地的风俗习惯。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你能轻松地回忆起某个地方的路线，或者轻松地使用某项工具，这说明什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示你对这个地方的路线，或者这项工具的用法，已经很了解了。

sentences: Are you ___ the safety procedures in the laboratory before starting work?

image_prompts: A list of grocery items with 'etc.' written at the bottom in elegant cursive
A bookshelf filled with various books, with 'etc.' representing more unseen books
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing the meaning of 'etc.' as 'and so on'.
words.image_desc_cn: 用插图展示“等等”的意思。
words.collocations: and etc.

examples.en: I need to buy milk, eggs, bread, etc. from the store.
examples.cn: 我需要从商店买牛奶、鸡蛋、面包等等。

examples.en: She enjoys reading books, watching movies, etc. in her free time.
examples.cn: 她空闲时喜欢读书、看电影等等。

socratic_questions.question: 当你列举了一些东西，但还有其他类似的东西没有列完，你会用什么来表示还有更多？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示“以及其他类似的东西”。

sentences: He likes playing basketball, football, ___ , during his spare time.

image_prompts: A spotlight shining on a grand piano on a stage, empty seats in the background
A trophy case filled with various awards and certificates, soft lighting
words.image_desc_en: A spotlight on a piano symbolizes musical talent; a trophy case represents recognition of talent.
words.image_desc_cn: 聚光灯下的钢琴象征音乐天赋；奖杯柜代表对才能的认可。
words.collocations: have a talent for, natural talent, discover talent

examples.en: She has a great talent for learning foreign languages quickly.
examples.cn: 她有学习外语的极高天赋，学得很快。

examples.en: His talent in painting was obvious from a very young age.
examples.cn: 他从小就展现出绘画方面的天赋。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人天生就擅长做某件事，我们称他拥有什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是一种与生俱来的能力，不需要太多努力就能做得很好。

sentences: Her musical ___ was evident when she started playing piano at age four.

image_prompts: An elegant handwritten letter addressed to a 'madam', vintage paper
A formal reception desk with a sign that reads 'Madam's Office', polished wood
words.image_desc_en: An elegant handwritten letter and a formal reception desk.
words.image_desc_cn: 一封优雅的手写信和正式的接待台。
words.meaning_cn: 夫人，女士（对女性的尊称）
words.collocations: Yes, madam; Good morning, madam

examples.en: Excuse me, madam, is this seat taken in the library?
examples.cn: 打扰一下，夫人，图书馆里的这个座位有人坐吗？

examples.en: Good morning, madam, how can I help you today in store?
examples.cn: 早上好，夫人，今天在商店里我能为您做些什么？

socratic_questions.question: 在正式场合，我们如何礼貌地称呼一位女士？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是一个表示尊敬的称呼，通常用于服务行业或正式场合。

sentences: The waiter politely asked, "Good evening, ____, may I take your order?"

image_prompts: A billboard displaying a colorful image of a new product, clear sky background
A magazine page with a visually appealing layout promoting a travel destination
words.image_desc_en: A visual representation of a product or service to attract attention.
words.image_desc_cn: 通过视觉方式呈现产品或服务，以吸引注意。
words.collocations: place an advertisement, run an advertisement, effective advertisement

examples.en: I saw an advertisement for the new phone on TV last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚在电视上看到了新款手机的广告。

examples.en: The advertisement in the newspaper caught my attention immediately.
examples.cn: 报纸上的广告立刻引起了我的注意。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想让更多人知道你的新产品，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 你需要一种方式来宣传你的产品，让人们了解它的优点。

sentences: The company spent a lot of money on the new ___ campaign.

image_prompts: A name tag with the name 'Robert' printed in bold letters on a dark background
A birthday cake with candles spelling out the name 'Robert' in frosting
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of the name 'Robert'.
words.image_desc_cn: “Robert”名字的视觉呈现。
words.collocations: Meet Robert, Call Robert

examples.en: Robert is a kind student in our class at school.
examples.cn: 罗伯特是我们班上一个友善的学生。

examples.en: I will ask Robert to help me with my English homework.
examples.cn: 我将请罗伯特帮我做英语作业。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要介绍一位新同学，并且你知道他的英文名字是“罗”，你会怎么称呼他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个名字通常用于西方国家，是一个常见的男性名字。

sentences: I met ___ at the library yesterday, and he was very helpful.

image_prompts: A map highlighting the location of Argentina in South America
A panoramic view of the Andes Mountains in Argentina, snow-capped peaks
words.image_desc_en: A map of Argentina and the Andes Mountains.
words.image_desc_cn: 阿根廷地图和安第斯山脉的景色。
words.collocations: visit Argentina, travel to Argentina, people from Argentina
words.preposition_combos: in Argentina, to Argentina, from Argentina

examples.en: My friend plans to visit Argentina during the summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我的朋友计划在暑假期间访问阿根廷。

examples.en: The tango dance originated in Argentina, a country in South America.
examples.cn: 探戈舞起源于阿根廷，一个位于南美洲的国家。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个南美洲国家以其探戈舞和足球文化而闻名？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个国家位于南美洲南部，以安第斯山脉和潘帕斯草原著称。

sentences: Lionel Messi is a famous football player from ___.

image_prompts: A helicopter hovering over a flooded town, delivering supplies to rooftops
An inflatable boat navigating through a disaster zone, carrying people to safety
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting disaster relief operations, showcasing rescue teams and equipment.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘灾难救援行动的图像，展示救援队和设备。
words.collocations: join Blue Sky Rescue, Blue Sky Rescue team, work with Blue Sky Rescue
words.preposition_combos: of Blue Sky Rescue, for Blue Sky Rescue, by Blue Sky Rescue

examples.en: The Blue Sky Rescue team arrived quickly after the earthquake.
examples.cn: 地震后，蓝天救援队迅速赶到。

examples.en: Many volunteers want to join Blue Sky Rescue to help others.
examples.cn: 许多志愿者想加入蓝天救援队去帮助他人。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个组织通常在自然灾害发生后提供紧急援助，例如地震或洪水？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个组织的名字包含“蓝天”和“救援”，暗示着希望和行动。

sentences: The ___ ___ ___ is known for its quick response to emergencies.

image_prompts: A map highlighting the archipelago of the Philippines in Southeast Asia
A vibrant coral reef teeming with marine life in the waters of the Philippines
words.image_desc_en: A map of the Philippines and a coral reef.
words.image_desc_cn: 菲律宾地图和珊瑚礁。
words.collocations: visit the Philippines, in the Philippines, from the Philippines
words.preposition_combos: in the Philippines, to the Philippines, from the Philippines

examples.en: I want to travel to the Philippines next summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我下个暑假想去菲律宾旅行。

examples.en: The Philippines is famous for its beautiful beaches and islands.
examples.cn: 菲律宾以其美丽的海滩和岛屿而闻名。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个东南亚国家以其成千上万的岛屿和潜水胜地而闻名？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个国家的名字听起来像一个群岛，以其自然美景而闻名。

sentences: She is planning a trip to the ___ to see the Chocolate Hills.

image_prompts: A single tree planted in a barren landscape, showing signs of new growth
A before-and-after image of a polluted river, with the 'after' side cleaned up and thriving
words.image_desc_en: A positive change or impact.
words.image_desc_cn: 积极的改变或影响。
words.collocations: make a big difference, make a positive difference, make a real difference

examples.en: Recycling can make a difference to our environment's future.
examples.cn: 回收利用能对我们环境的未来产生影响。

examples.en: Volunteering at the local shelter can make a difference in lives.
examples.cn: 在当地收容所做志愿者可以对他人的生活产生影响。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你帮助了一个需要帮助的人，你觉得会对他们有什么影响？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示通过行动带来积极的变化。

sentences: Small acts of kindness can ___ in someone's day.

image_prompts: A guest book open on a table in a hotel lobby, with several signatures
A museum exhibit with a small crowd observing a dinosaur skeleton
words.image_desc_en: A guest book and a museum exhibit.
words.image_desc_cn: 访客登记簿和博物馆展览。
words.collocations: foreign visitor, frequent visitor, welcome visitor

examples.en: The museum had many visitors during the summer vacation this year.
examples.cn: 今年暑假期间，这家博物馆有很多参观者。

examples.en: We had a visitor from Canada who stayed with us last week.
examples.cn: 上周我们有一位来自加拿大的访客和我们住在一起。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你去一个旅游景点，你会成为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是去某个地方参观的人。

sentences: The park attracts many ___ every year, especially during the spring.

image_prompts: A walking cane resting against a rocking chair on a porch, soft afternoon light
A pair of spectacles lying on top of a book with large print, warm lighting
words.image_desc_en: An image representing old age and associated items.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表老年和相关物品的图像。
words.collocations: elderly people, elderly care, elderly home

examples.en: The elderly woman needs help crossing the busy street safely.
examples.cn: 那位年长的妇女需要帮助才能安全地穿过繁忙的街道。

examples.en: Our community center offers many activities for the elderly residents.
examples.cn: 我们的社区中心为年长的居民提供许多活动。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一位需要更多关怀和帮助的人的年龄阶段。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容的是那些已经活了很多年，身体可能比较虚弱的人。

sentences: The hospital provides special care for ___ patients with chronic diseases.

image_prompts: A group of canes leaning against a park bench, autumn leaves scattered around
A row of rocking chairs on a porch, each with a knitted blanket draped over it
words.image_desc_en: Canes leaning against a bench; rocking chairs with blankets.
words.image_desc_cn: 靠在长椅上的拐杖；带有毯子的摇椅。
words.usage: n. (集合名词，前需加定冠词 the)
words.collocations: care for the elderly, respect for the elderly

examples.en: We should show respect and care for the elderly in our community.
examples.cn: 我们应该尊重和关心我们社区里的老年人。

examples.en: The local library offers special programs for the elderly every week.
examples.cn: 当地图书馆每周都为老年人提供特别项目。

socratic_questions.question: 在社会中，我们应该特别关注哪个年龄段的人，他们可能需要更多的帮助和关怀？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个群体通常指年龄较大，可能面临健康或生活挑战的人。

sentences: The government provides financial support for ___ to cover their medical expenses.

image_prompts: A detailed blueprint of a building's structure, showcasing interconnected systems
A neatly arranged office desk with labeled folders and organized stationery
words.image_desc_en: Images representing structure and order.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表结构和秩序的图像。
words.collocations: international organization, charitable organization, join an organization
words.preposition_combos: in an organization, of an organization

examples.en: Our school has a student organization that plans many activities.
examples.cn: 我们学校有一个学生组织，计划了很多活动。

examples.en: He wants to join an organization that helps protect the environment.
examples.cn: 他想加入一个帮助保护环境的组织。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一群人为了共同的目标聚集在一起，并且有明确的分工和规则，这通常被称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词强调的是有目的的结构和安排，而不是随意的人群聚集。

sentences: The United Nations is a global ___ that promotes peace and cooperation.

image_prompts: A wide shot of a large, empty stadium with rows of colorful seats
Aerial view of a circular stadium with a retractable roof, green field inside
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting a large stadium with seating and a field.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘一个带有座位和场地的大型体育场的图像。
words.collocations: football stadium, Olympic stadium, packed stadium
words.preposition_combos: in a stadium, at the stadium, near the stadium

examples.en: The new stadium is near my home, so I often go there.
examples.cn: 新体育场离我家很近，所以我经常去那里。

examples.en: Our school will hold the sports meeting in the stadium next week.
examples.cn: 我们学校下周将在体育场举行运动会。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想观看一场大型足球比赛，通常会去哪里？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是一个大型的、通常是露天的场所，有座位围绕着比赛场地。

sentences: The concert was held in a large ___ that could hold 50,000 people.

image_prompts: A hand offering a plate of fresh fruit, healthy eating
A solar panel installation on a rooftop, generating electricity
words.image_desc_en: Offering or generating something needed or useful.
words.image_desc_cn: 提供或产生某样需要或有用的东西。
words.usage: v. (provided, provided) to supply something that is needed or wanted
words.collocations: provide for, provide with, provide support
words.preposition_combos: provide sth. for sb., provide sb. with sth.

examples.en: Parents should provide enough love and care for their children.
examples.cn: 父母应该为他们的孩子提供足够的爱和关怀。

examples.en: This website can provide useful information for your English study.
examples.cn: 这个网站可以为你的英语学习提供有用的信息。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的朋友生病了，你会做什么来帮助他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑给予实际的帮助，例如食物或药物。

sentences: The school will ___ all the necessary books for the students.

image_prompts: A stack of tin cans of various sizes and colors, neatly arranged on a shelf
An open tin can with a spoon resting inside, filled with colorful fruit salad
words.image_desc_en: Various tin cans and an open can of fruit salad.
words.image_desc_cn: 各种各样的锡罐和一个打开的装满水果沙拉的罐头。
words.collocations: can do, can see, can help

examples.en: I can play the guitar, but I am not very good.
examples.cn: 我会弹吉他，但我弹得不太好。

examples.en: You can borrow my book if you promise to return it.
examples.cn: 如果你保证归还，你可以借我的书。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你学会了一项新技能，比如游泳，你会怎么描述你现在具备的能力？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述具备某种能力或可能性。

sentences: She ___ speak three languages fluently: English, French, and Spanish.

image_prompts: A set of keys on a wooden table next to a document with the word 'Deed' on it
A collar with a tag that reads 'If lost, call...' lying next to a dog bowl
words.image_desc_en: A person who owns something.
words.image_desc_cn: 拥有某物的人。
words.collocations: property owner, pet owner, business owner

examples.en: He is the owner of a famous restaurant in this city.
examples.cn: 他是这个城市一家著名餐厅的所有者。

examples.en: The dog is very loyal to its owner, following him everywhere.
examples.cn: 这只狗对它的主人非常忠诚，无论他去哪里都跟着。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你买了一套房子，你会成为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是对某物拥有所有权的人。

sentences: The ___ of the company decided to invest in new technology.
